Fifth pre-release of 1.3 — free blurb look-up without surprises, and a few settings for the interface.

## New

- **Own Google Books API key.** *Settings > Books > Blurbs* takes an optional key of your own. Without one, Google Books often answers "quota exceeded" because everyone without a key shares one daily quota. A key is free (Google Cloud Console: enable the Books API, create an API key); it is also used for looking up covers.
- **Status symbols per place.** *Settings > General > Interface > Status symbols*: tick for every pictogram whether it shows in the sidebar, the book lists and the library's status column. Hidden pictograms still count for filters and for sorting by status.
- **Where a double-click opens a book.** *Settings > General > Interface*: Chapters (default), Metadata, the Preview or straight into KOReader (Preview and KOReader not on Windows). A right-click on a book in the library offers all of them.

## Changed

- **Look-up says why nothing was found.** The message at the end lists per source what happened: daily quota used up (429), book found but no blurb stored, or book not found. The result also stays below the blurb field as long as the book has no text. A quota or network error is not remembered as tried, so the next look-up asks again.
- **Resizable cover panel.** Drag the divider between the Metadata form and the cover; the width is remembered, a double-click restores the default.
- **Large cover closes on a second click.** Clicking the cover again closes the large view, and so does choosing another book. Only one large cover window is open at a time.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.3-beta5.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
